raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR filter added in DE-412 drops valid POSTED transactions that arrive late. Batches 3-14 deliver many events 2-3 days after txn_ts, and the only other drop in silver is the intended REVERSED filter. txn_id is unique, so there are no duplicates for a staleness filter to remove. I am removing the filter and keeping the POSTED filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
